title: Switch
description: A checkbox with role=switch, for settings that take effect immediately rather than on submit

props.name: label
props.description: Switch: visible label wrapping the native checkbox with role="switch".

props.name: spread
props.description: Switch: place the label before the control and spread the row; defaults to false.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Switch: classes on the outer label. className, ref and checked/onChange target the input; SwitchGroup accepts native div props.
